dek: At least 88 civilians have been killed and 157 others injured in 239 airstrikes carried out by the Myanmar Air Force from Aug. 8-23, according to a report released by the National Unity Government (NUG). The intensified aerial bombardment spanned Sagaing, Magway, Mandalay, Tanintharyi, and Bago regions, as well as Arak
